tagline: Defense-focused REIT owning mission-critical properties near U.S. Government installations
hero_kpi_rationale: The Defense/IT portfolio is the primary driver of the company's business, representing 92.1% of square footage and 90.3% of revenue, with high and stable occupancy reflecting structural demand for national security-critical properties.

kpis.name: Defense/IT Portfolio Occupancy Rate
kpis.explanation: Occupancy rate of the Defense/IT portfolio as of December 31, 2025
kpis.description: The Defense/IT portfolio occupancy rate is a key indicator of demand for real estate assets located near U.S. defense installations, which are critical to national security.
kpis.signal: High and stable occupancy, nine consecutive years above 93%

kpis.name: Tenant Retention Rate
kpis.explanation: Tenant retention rate for the Defense/IT portfolio in 2025
kpis.description: Tenant retention rate is a key indicator of tenant satisfaction and portfolio stability, reflecting the significant security investments that make relocations difficult.
kpis.signal: 10th consecutive year with retention rate of at least 75%, cash rent increases of 2.7%, and straight-line rent increases of 11.0%

kpis.name: Same Property Occupancy Rate
kpis.explanation: Occupancy rate of the same-store pool within the Defense/IT portfolio as of December 31, 2025
kpis.description: Same property occupancy excludes the impact of acquisitions and recent developments, providing a comparable performance measure of the existing property base.
kpis.signal: Average pool increase from 95.9% (2024) to 96.0% annualized, decline in same-store pool due to non-renewals

kpis.name: Development Pipeline
kpis.explanation: Total square footage of properties under development as of December 31, 2025
kpis.description: The development pipeline represents external growth investments to meet strong demand in the Defense/IT portfolio, including pre-leased properties and developments for anticipated future demand.
kpis.signal: 646,000 square feet across 5 properties, 58% pre-leased, expected investment of approximately $233.4 million

kpis.name: Total Portfolio Square Footage
kpis.explanation: Total square footage of the operational portfolio including properties under development as of December 31, 2025
kpis.description: Total portfolio square footage reflects the company's asset base, including 201 operational properties totaling 23.2 million square feet as of December 31, 2025.
kpis.signal: 201 operational properties plus 5 under development, growth through development and acquisition

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Revenue of $0.764 billion in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of $0.014 billion in the latest fiscal year (FY2021).

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.description: Operating income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Operating income of $0.136 billion in the latest fiscal year (FY2017).

risks.title: Concentration of Tenants with the U.S. Government
risks.summary: Revenue concentration with the U.S. Government exposes the company to risks from budget reductions, prolonged government shutdowns, or shifts in defense priorities.
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on the U.S. Government and its defense contractors, which represent the vast majority of its revenue. Changes in defense budgets, funding reductions, or government shutdowns could significantly impact revenue. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Economic Downturn and Real Estate Market Conditions
risks.summary: Economic downturn, rising interest rates, and unfavorable real estate market conditions could reduce demand for properties and increase financing costs.
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to general economic risks including reduced demand, rising interest rates, inflation, and unfavorable real estate market conditions that could lower revenues and increase borrowing costs. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Development and Acquisition Risks
risks.summary: Risks related to development and acquisitions could lead to unexpected costs, delays in project completion, and integration challenges affecting expected returns.
risks.score_rationale: The company faces development risks including construction cost overruns, delivery delays, and lease-up risks. Acquisitions carry integration risks and potential environmental liabilities. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Illiquidity of Real Estate Investments
risks.summary: The illiquidity of real estate investments could limit the company's ability to respond quickly to market changes or fund new opportunities.
risks.score_rationale: The company's real estate investments are illiquid, meaning it may have difficulty selling them quickly in response to liquidity needs or strategic shifts. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Environmental and Regulatory Risks
risks.summary: Evolving environmental regulations could result in unexpected costs and remediation obligations for the company.
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to environmental laws and regulations that could expose it to cleanup or remediation costs in the event of property contamination. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Dependence on Defense Sector Dynamics
risks.summary: Changes in defense priorities, space programs, or cybersecurity missions could reduce demand for certain specialized properties in the portfolio.
risks.score_rationale: While the Defense/IT portfolio benefits from bipartisan support for defense budget increases, shifts in defense priorities, program reductions, or geopolitical developments could affect demand. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Competition and Local Market Conditions
risks.summary: Increased competition could lead to downward pressure on rents and higher marketing and tenant retention costs.
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in competitive markets where other commercial real estate owners compete for tenants, which could exert downward pressure on rental rates. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies is present in CDP's 10-K filing.
